title: Improvement: `thiserror` crate usage in the Rust COM API
body:
### What

The COM concept crate uses thiserror::Error derives on its public error enums. The #[error(...)] attributes provide error display messages, and the derive generates the standard error implementations at compile time. The error enums and their variants are part of the Rust COM API.

Acceptance criteria

- Record the pinned crate version, enabled features, and error types using the derive.
- Review the generated behavior, provenance, license, maintenance status, and safety relevance.
- Document whether to retain thiserror or implement the required error traits directly.
- Record the required qualification artifacts and any API or maintenance impact of the decision.
